About the Institution

The University of Manchester is a public research university in Manchester, England. It is a member of the prestigious Russell Group and was formed in 2004 by the merger of the University of Manchester Institute of Science and Technology (UMIST) and the Victoria University of Manchester.

Campus Environment

Manchester is famously known as the ultimate student city. The campus is integrated into the heart of the city's Oxford Road corridor, surrounded by music venues, theaters, art galleries, and modern student hubs.
